about: Named looks from references/styles.md, grouped under the six presets (STYLE-VOCAB-PROPOSALS.md section 2). A look style is a Q-dir-01 answer: it selects its preset, and its dials sit between the preset and the person's own dial values (explicit > style > preset > coupling). build: settings the engine builds beyond the dials. Layout, texture, image and drawing styles pair with a look and never change the preset. Dial values are midpoints of styles.md ranges [inferred], or the values the brand/showcase/styles studies tested. A style's dials are not moved by feel words. Warmth stays at 45 or below in every style: higher warmth turns the neutral greys beige (#efebe8 at 80 against #ebebeb at 50, brand/showcase/styles/PROCESS-01-04.md). Each style sits on 15 trait axes (bones: shape, type, scale, layout, density, theme; skin: the rest; research/F-exploration-methods findings); a style without its own dials or build gets them from its traits (engine.py style_from_traits). Experimental and custom styles use the same axes and live in the person's state (customStyles), never here.

surface.about: what a panel is made of

edge.about: how an edge is drawn (control edges always keep 3:1)

depth.about: how things lift off the page

values.soft-shadow: soft shadows that grow with height
values.extruded: shapes pushed out of the page

color.about: how much color, and which kind

contrast.about: how far apart lights and darks sit in the decoration; it never lowers text (4.5:1) or control (3:1) contrast

type.about: the letter style that carries the look (the font itself stays the person's choice)

scale.about: the size jump between headlines and body text

texture.about: a layer over flat color, kept off body text

imagery.about: what kind of pictures carry the look

density.about: how much fits on a screen; complexity costs first impressions most

motion.about: the character of movement (reduced motion always gets a still version)

theme.about: which theme is designed first; light and dark are always both built

traitWords.about: Everyday words for single traits, so a look with no name can still be found and built [inferred].

styleWords.about: Everyday look words mapped to named styles, best first (styles.md 'Their words, and the styles to show') [inferred]. A word that is also a feel word keeps its feel settings and only suggests styles; a word that is only a style word starts the sketch from that style, recorded as assumed. Words in suggestOnly are moods or single traits: they list styles to show but never start the sketch from one.
